records.title: Renewable solar generation
records.claim: 779,682.30 kWh of renewable solar energy generated in 2024.

source.title: Make A Mark ESG Report
source.location: Printed p. 26 (PDF p. 25); footnote 14, printed p. 93

records.reviewNote: Source-reviewed for this prototype. The report attributes the data to its solar panel provider.
limitations: This is generation, not total energy use, avoided emissions, or a whole-team renewable-energy percentage.
The report-level limited assurance statement covers the corporate GHG inventory; it does not say this solar figure was independently assured.

records.title: Nationalities represented
records.claim: 23 nationalities represented within Aston Martin Aramco Formula One™ Team.

source.title: Make A Mark ESG Report
source.location: Printed p. 60 (PDF p. 59); footnote 24, printed p. 93

records.reviewNote: Source-reviewed for this prototype. The report identifies the 2023 DE&I Survey as the underlying source.
limitations: The report does not state the survey response rate or workforce denominator.
Do not infer survey representativeness, nationality balance, or change over time from this count.

records.title: Students reached at Make A Mark Day
records.claim: The team reports reaching and inspiring more than 300 students to pursue STEM careers during Make A Mark Day in British Grand Prix week.

source.title: Make A Mark ESG Report
source.location: Printed p. 12 (PDF p. 11); detail on printed p. 68 (PDF p. 67)

records.reviewNote: Source-reviewed for this prototype. The report attributes the programme and reach count to the team.
limitations: The report does not describe its count method, attendance list, or unique-participant definition.
The report does not measure whether participants later pursued STEM careers; preserve the reported reach wording.
